title: HostOrganizerBillViewDocument
description: Server-maintained owner read view of one of Catch's bills to an organizer, for the Host Organiser tab and Payments screen: exactly the row listOrganizerBills returns for it. The view id is the billId. Written by a trigger on organizerBills; a bill still waiting to be sent has no view. Reminders, history, terms revisions, staff ids and the payment link id stay on the bill; the payment link URL is present only while the bill is unpaid. Never identity, permission or mutation authority: the organizer's current owner reads it under rules.
x-owner: Host read model projector (hostReadModels organizer bill view trigger) from organizerBills
